profile.headline: I find insights in data - Data Analysis/Business Intelligence/Data Science
profile.summary:
Successful in both staff and consultant positions performing midrange system operation, network administration, data analysis, ETL, help desk, program design, database design, business analysis, and BI programming. Have written programs for MVS (IBM mainframe) , VMS (DEC midrange), UNIX, IBM i-series and Windows.

Have worked in several areas of the military including aviation, operations, intelligence analysis, and electronic warfare. Have held Secret and Top Secret clearances.

Contact Information
801-849-8664
SmithRussell@comcast.net

positions.title: Sorftware Developer
positions.description: Maintain existing software to keep status boards and dashboards working properly. Update Excel/VBA to accommodate new processes. Participate in special projects as required using R and Exce/Power Query.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Tasked with troubleshooting printing errors. User has new instance of Windows Server and uses dot matrix printers to print multi-part forms. Printer performance was inconsistent as some users could print successfully and others got illegible printouts. Printer manufacturer had conflicting information on their website as to whether a current print driver was available for the printer. I presented owner with two alternatives. He made the selection and is now printing successfully from all stations and all user IDs.

positions.title: Service Representative
positions.description: Requested computers and associated stock for nine parts rooms at Delta Air Lines facilities. Requested and tracked parts to repair escalated problems for approximately 105 airports in US and Eastern Asia. Initiated Return Maintenance Authorizations for all faulty parts moving through Salt Lake City and routed them to the applicable repair vendors. Arranged for on-site repairs through authorized repair centers. Used HP Service Manager for workflow management.

positions.title: Technical Support Agent
positions.description: Took calls from Dell customers who were experiencing difficulties with their computer or peripherals. The scope included wireless and wired internet problems. Documented calls for future reference. For part of this period, I was on a specialty team that made outbound calls to customers with more complex problems.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Engagement was an application outsourcing contract at an insurance company in Vermont. Assignment was to troubleshoot and run all periodic reports built by SAS software. Further instructions were to clean up the 400+ SAS programs that ran at month end. This consisted primarily of scripting so fewer programs had to be called individually. Data used was either in SQL Server or DB2 on AS/400.

positions.title: SAS Consultant
positions.description: Client actuaries wanted to extend the forecasting ability of existing SAS programs. Team was tasked to edit 120+ existing programs to use larger arrays. Team had to test software and load to the production VMS server.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Worked as business analyst. Programmed in SAS (vers 6,8,9) on MVS, VMS, Unix and Windows. Converted version 6 SAS programs using Oracle descriptors to run on SAS version 8 and later. Worked on team of VB programmers. Wrote/troubleshot programs to automate Access and Excel. Worked in multiple client departments to troubleshoot hardware incompatibilities.

positions.title: Rotary Wing Aviator
positions.description: Hold an FAA Rotary Wing Pilot certificate with Commercial and Instrument ratings. Was trained in all tactics used by U S Army including night vision goggles, hoist operations, low-level flight and reconnaisance operations.

volunteerExperiences.description: Intermountain Healing Hearts supports several fundraising efforts to better enable hospitals, doctors and research facilities to find treatments for congenital heart defects. Many children are born with heart defects that cause them to spend months in the hospital throughout their lives. Some children have a chance to survive and thrive where a few years ago, people born with the same conditions would have lived very sedentary, sometimes short lives. Intermountain Healing Hearts sponsors walks during the year which help raise funds for research and better patient care.
